text:
Maya: Heads-up — we have a sprint rollout window today at 18:00 UTC for release train 7. Need lane owners and smoke volunteers. Planning: staggered canary, 10% -> 50% -> full, 15m observation per step.
Kevin: I can take the inference lane (canary + smoke).
Jordan: I’ll own console and dashboard routes. will be available in the hotseat 17:45-19:30 UTC.
Sophia: I’ll run the smoke checklist for infra + embeddings service. Where do you want smoke logs to land?
Maya: put smoke logs in #eng-releases-smoke (upload artifacts) and attach perf traces to the ticket. Also ping me if errors > 5% or tail lat spikes.
Alekh: I’ll be on-call for rollback. If we need to revert, I can kick the fallback. leaving my phone reachable.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: "Train7-orbit" start=2026-03-17T18:00:00Z owner=@Maya. Canary job queued. https://ci.internal/release/7
Maya: Minimal smoke checklist (short):
- confirm canary image hash matches manifest
- run healthcheck on /live and /ready
- sanity queries for top 10 prompts
- embeddings smoke (sample 20 texts)
- check cost/latency dashboards
Example rollback commands:
```
# rollback to previous replica set
kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-service -n prod --to-revision=42
# quick route flip (NGINX):
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/route/switch -d '{"route":"stable"}'
```
Kevin: For canary percent do we start at 5% or 10%? I prefer 10% given current traffic.
Sophia: 10% is fine, observe for 15m, then 50% for 10m if stable. Add a smoke-run at each step.
Jordan: FYI I’ll keep canary isolation on the dashboard so customer-facing queries are unaffected.
Nina: infra oncall here — I’ll monitor infra alerts and will escalate at first sign of host OOM or pod crashloop. Ping me in thread if you force a rollback.
Maya: Great — final roster: Kevin (inference canary + smoke), Jordan (console + dashboard), Sophia (embeddings + infra smoke), Alekh (rollback/ops), Nina (infra monitor). Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sophia: :thumbsup:
Alekh: :thumbsup:
Nina: :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — I’ll send a preflight checklist at 17:30 UTC and a last-call 10m before window. If anything changes, update this thread.
